lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular nodes; a distinct grouping of 6-8 high-intensity maxima is visible posterior to the gill slits forming a semi-regular polygonal cluster.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal spot alignments, forming a faint grid-like pattern most prominent in the mid-flank and posterior regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is present along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transition from high intensity (dorsal) to low intensity (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs primarily localized to the posterior margin and lower third of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
